steps.speaker: Timecop
steps.content:
<size=32>Quack! Quack quack quack quack, quack quack! Quack quack quack!!
(All members of Operation Stella Hunt have arrived at the center of the distortion field! Reappearance of destructive high-energy singularity confirmed! We've caught up with it!)</size>

steps.speaker: Timecop
steps.content:
Quack... Quack quack quack... Quack quack quack quack
 quack!!!
(But... but it's stronger than last time!)

<size=32>At the edge of WhiteSands, a lavish, eerie theater rises out of the mirage. The Apostle S.T. perches atop it, having already healed from its injuries. It's even stronger after ravaging Dillywood and the DisCars, and now the entire area is saturated in manic delusion.</size>

steps.speaker: Timecop
steps.content:
Quack quack... Quack quack quack quack... Quack quack. Quuuuaaaack...
(How did this happen? We suffered such heavy losses to injure it, but now everything is back to square one!)

steps.speaker: Timecop
steps.content:
Quuuuaaaack...?!
(Were our efforts all meaningless and in vain?)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack.
(There's no such thing as a meaningless battle. Our enemy interferes with mind and matter, and we are born from the will to fight it.)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack.
(As long as our spirit carries on and the battle continues, even if our bodies die, there will be others to take up our quarrel with the foe!)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack!
(Come! Onwards to the final battle!)

steps.speaker: Timecop
steps.content:
Quack...
(Commander...)

steps.speaker: Timecop
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack... 
(Sounds like you stole someone else's lines. You gotta stick to the character design...)

steps.speaker: Timecop
steps.content:
Quack quack! Quack quack quack! Quack quack!
(Commander! That small singularity has appeared with its companion!)

Swoosh... A dusty, medium-sized van swerves through the streets of Dillywood. It dodges many strange creatures that have concretized, but at the last minute, it fails to brake in time and slams into the jelly monster enveloping the whole theater.
Before the vehicle gets completely gobbled up by the jelly, someone kicks open the door.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Here again. It's really addicted to the glamor of Dillywood.

${PlayerName} turns around to take out a bunch of strange, blue luminous triangles from the car, then pins them all over OwO's vest and hair. Finally, one in each of her palms, and makes her clench them tightly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: These are talismans that will protect you. Don't let go of them. When you feel unwell, clench down on them tighter. We don't know what it's like inside. Follow me and don't get lost!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Okay.
OwO puts Stella to her waist and grabs the hem of ${PlayerName}'s clothes, following him into the theater.
steps.female_content: OwO puts Stella to her waist and grabs the hem of ${PlayerName}'s clothes, following her into the theater.

steps.content: <size=32>Inside, the little theater has become a vast, illusory space. Giant, eerie things like telephone booths, buses, and clock towers float about, while something is constantly condensing and dissolving in the air. Someone's fantasy is gradually taking form.</size>
Underneath their feet, a long staircase extends out into the depths, leading to the flaming nova at the center of the illusion.

steps.speaker: os (unshown)
steps.content: This is the power of Stella's family... They have the power to turn fantasy into reality...

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: If Lynn was there, how would she capture this on camera? Wouldn't it be cool if we could film it chasing us with one long shot?

steps.speaker: [Transition]
steps.content: Monster roars

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: What impressive sound effects! It's coming from all directions.

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: Is this the Dooby 18 surround sound that Love was talking about? I don't just hear it in my ears. It's practically vibrating my heart!

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: The background music is also very exciting. Very fitting for an action scene. Will Lil Daisy use this kind of music, too?

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: So much dazzling fantasy! It'd be really awesome if this got filmed. Stella's family is so cool. They're truly great mascots for my studio.
She looks at ${PlayerName}'s back in front of her. ${PlayerName} has a very serious expression right now, looking not at all like the usual little clapper.

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: Is this the makeup that ${PlayerName} put on specially for today? Is it to look cooler and more serious for the "final climax"?

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: Haha, what a hard worker. OwO will satisfy him, then.
steps.female_content: Haha, what a hard worker. OwO will satisfy her, then.

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: What am I thinking... I'm not making a film anymore. I'm only here to send Stella home...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OwO?!!!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh?
Woosh!!!
After losing focus for just a moment, purple tentacles that OwO had never seen before wrap around her waist and pull her away from the narrow staircase.
OwO loses her grip on ${PlayerName} and gets transported to a small planet. Stella jumps in front of her and bears its teeth at the enemies, yet the little critter looks so small in comparison.

OwO instinctively throws her lion head over to protect Stella. Huge purple jelly monsters surround her, staring and wielding their tentacles. They warp and remold reality into bizarre forms wherever they go. OwO senses that something's very wrong.

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: These purple monsters... aren't Stella's family. They're something else. I have to break through their encirclement. Come on, OwO, you can do it! You have to do it.

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: You promised to bring Stella home. I have to make it happen while it's still possible. I must try harder and think of a way...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: A story can't be smooth sailing all the time. A movie without ups and downs will put people to sleep. Dreams will always clash with reality. There will always be one obstacle after the next, and an unbridgeable gulf before us.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: In movies, the hero will try their best to overcome the gulf and realize their dream. This is what the audience wants to see.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: The climax of the story is when their dream finally comes true, bringing everyone to the perfect ending.

steps.speaker: os
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What do I have to do... to reach the perfect ending?
Uh! Duck down!
A sharp shout suddenly rings out, startling OwO. She instinctively squats down and covers her head with her hands.
Then, a laser jet pierces through a jelly tentacle. Soon, jets of blazing light sweep across the room, pulverizing all the jelly monsters surrounding OwO.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Are those laser jets from... Lynn?
A few seconds later, a bumpy little spaceship chugs along and lands in front of OwO. The cabin door is wide open, and Lynn, Love, and Daisy are crammed in the single-pilot cockpit.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Huff... Huff... Oh good, I caught up...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...How come you guys are here? Why...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: To make a movie, of course!
She jumps down, picks up OwO by the armpits and puts her into the cockpit as she brags loudly.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh! We robbed... ahhh no, I mean, we accepted this spaceship as a gift from the Timecops. They're counting on My Best Cool Car to resolve this crisis!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: It's too crowded for us to all be in it, but it's perfect for you... practically tailor-made! From this point onwards, we'll leave everything to you!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Send Stella home, and give the happiest ending for My Best Cool Car's movie!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Sigh...<size=28> You've done so much radio, yet you still sound so wooden...</size>

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: OwO, promises have to be kept. You promised to give us a movie filled with fun, but it's not done yet.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Go finish it. We had a great time watching it. We want to see the ending.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But... ahhh!

<size=32>The spaceship goes into the air, carrying OwO, Stella, and the lion head. The shadows in the night sky begin to stir once more, gathering around the small planet. The fidgeting blonde girl finally can't hold herself back, and starts shouting her feelings to OwO.</size>

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I can't memorize that many lines, but I got my courage from you, so I hope you can realize your own wish!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Send Stella home!! We'll be watching you!
The spaceship sets off amidst OwO's protests, barely breaking through the blockade. The shadows devour the small planet and the three figures on it, then chase after the rickety little spaceship.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ah... no... no!! Stop quacking, stupid duck ship! Go back and help them!!

She slaps the control panel in panic. The spaceship shudders, entangled by purple shadows from the void. Stella the Starbeast glows all over, wielding its claws at the shadows. But this time, it can't repel their attack.
The spaceship gets slowly dragged towards the purple void behind it...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh... What are these... red... spikes...?
The red shackles dispel the shadows. Growing out like branches, they attach to OwO's little spaceship and slowly pull it back to the staircase.
A familiar person opens the cockpit door and takes OwO out.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...${PlayerName}...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Stella's family didn't listen at all. They were so angry...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What do I do... Lynn, Love and Lil Daisy have all been taken away...
${PlayerName} doesn't respond right away, but reaches out to wipe away OwO's tears.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since when did the world's best Lion Dancing Queen become a little crybaby?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Wh-what are you talking about! Look! Those shadows are coming again. They devoured everyone. We're next!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Will sending Stella home really end all this? Maybe I was wrong. If this keeps up...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OwO.
${PlayerName} interrupts her and clasps her cheeks with both hands, squeezing a somewhat comical expression out of her somber face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They weren't devoured. They stayed behind to clear up this misunderstanding with Stella's family. I'll go help them as soon as I plow open a path for you.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...What does "plow" mean?
${PlayerName} chuckles. He raises his hand and casts the red light again, scattering the creatures surging towards them.
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName} chuckles. She raises her hand and casts the red light again, scattering the creatures surging towards them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not wrong. Stella has been lost for so long that its family members have grown crazy from worry. That's why they're like this now. These dark shadows are their anxious feelings.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Go, send Stella home. That way, they won't be mad anymore, and everyone will come back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is the climax of the movie. You're the hero, so you must stay true to your goal. We don't need any awards. My Best Cool Car just wants to witness OwO's story.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: My story?

${PlayerName} picks up the lion's head, puts it on OwO's head, then turns her around by the shoulder. In front of OwO, the broken staircase has been repaired, leading all the way to where the stars are gathered.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your story doesn't need that lame award podium.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Soar beyond the DisCars. Soar to the world.

steps.content: You are the pride of My Best Cool Car.
He pushes OwO to take the first step.
steps.female_content: She pushes OwO to take the first step.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Run! I'll take care of things back here. You have to keep moving forward. The big happy ending is just ahead! Run...
His voice gets instantly drowned out.
steps.female_content: Her voice gets instantly drowned out.

steps.content: The shadows don't catch up from behind. OwO dashes forward with Stella at her waist and the lion's head on her head, panting and choking back tears.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sob... Sob... Waaah!!!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You liar! This isn't a movie set! There aren't any cameras around here! You're a big liar, ${PlayerName}! A great dummy liar!
A few purple jelly monsters try to block the path and stop OwO. They seem to be murmuring some strange words amidst the chaos...

steps.speaker: Purple Jelly Monster
steps.content: Slow down... It's not time yet, wait a bit longer... Wait for them to get here... We need them to all be together...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Move aside! Owoooo!!!
With a roar, she rolls forward with her lion's head and knocks the jelly monsters off the staircase.

OwO runs faster and faster. No one can hold her back now. The little golden lion zips down the path like a meteor. She finally reaches the end of the stairs, coming face to face with the humongous Starbeast.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I don't know if you're Stella's mom or dad or grandma or grandpa, but I've brought Stella back! Stop being angry already!

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes S.T.
steps.content: Woosh... Woosh...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I know you're angry and sad because you can't find Stella. I also lost my homeland. I know how you feel!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But you can't just keep throwing tantrums and bullying my friends! They're all good people who risked their lives to bring us here, but ended up losing themselves along the way! Go ask Stella if you don't believe me!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Now that Stella is back, you have to behave, too!

The Apostle can't be reasoned with at all. With a swing of its claw, S.T. destroys the stair that OwO is standing on. Disregarding any family ties, it slams the little blue critter, the girl and her lion's head into the debris with its claw.
The stairs gradually crumble. The Apostle keeps holding down its claw for a few seconds, as if affirming its own victory—then suddenly lifts it up again like a scalded creature.

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes S.T.
steps.content: Awoo?
Amidst the cracks is a mirage of a lion's head. Its surroundings begin to burn, emitting blinding light.
But OwO isn't there. S.T. shudders and lifts its head to see a little golden figure in the night sky, soaring like the scorching sun.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: How... rude!!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's bad enough that you're mean to me, but how dare you do that to Stella! I'm going to teach you a lesson!

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Squeak!!!

OwO takes a most splendiferous leap and deals a louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning blow to the center of the huge Apostle's forehead. The manic power makes it numb from head to toe, and the girl shrieks louder than a thunderstorm.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Give me back My Best Cool Car!
